description: Export Account Statement. Part of the Export Account Statement APIs in Giddh. Requires portal session.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: asc. Optional.

accountCurrency.description: Account currency query parameter. Default: true. Optional.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint). Optional.

fileType.description: Output file type. Default: xlsx. Optional.

lang.description: Locale/language code for translated labels. Default: StaticMessageSource.DEFAULT_LANG. Optional.
